summary: Blue Moon Metals Inc. filed a Form 6-K on July 30, 2026, reporting voting results from its Annual General and Special Meeting. Shareholders approved all items, including board size, share compensation plan, continuance from British Columbia to Ontario, and election of eight directors. The meeting had 68.60% voter turnout. This is a routine corporate governance disclosure with no special-situation event (no acquisition, tender, restructuring, or strategic review). The filing is informational only, providing standard meeting outcomes. No deal terms, premiums, or transactions are involved. This is not a special situation; it is an ordinary AGM results report.
